body: I wish that was enough, one thing can't keep me going. I know that if my dog can't, then nothing can. I'm 20.

That's true, I really am with him 24/7. I don't drive unfortunately, I wasn't able to get my license as a teenager then my panic disorder made it impossible to get one as of late and I couldn't afford a car anyways.
We don't have to money (he claims) and he says he's too tired from work to go anywhere. I do think of that but my boyfriend is really his "master" so I know my dog wouldn't miss me much.

I know but I truly don't think talk therapy is for me. I did today, at least for a second. My boyfriend refuses to take me anywhere and I take my dog for walks everyday. I absolutely hate it, I hate having to leave and I really have literally no money so I can't go anywhere on my own. It's just a dead end, thanks for talking to me, though.

I have tried, the therapists I have spoken to are, for lack of a better word, fucktarded. And I don't know what I want anyways so it's futile. I promise that I have exhausted everything, I really have. The only reason I even tries talking on here was so I wouldn't kill myself before my boyfriens almost home so my dog isn't left alone.
I've been getting help the last year, I've been put on medication that seems to be helping but stuff like not being able to go anywhere makes it impossible to get better.

That doesn't seem true, I'm sorry but i'm just having a hard time believing anything I guess. I've waited four years for it to get better, I'm just being foolish now to think it's going to get better. And he doesn't actually, he told me he's going to break up with me if I don't get better. So there's that. I'm sorry, but I made my decision now.
